AS50_GRID.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game animation source sheet. Asset type: candidate full-body 2D cel sheet for existing TMB Dao Tu AS50. Image 1 is the frozen identity: preserve exact face, large dark eyes, swept tied black hair, red-black-gold outfit, jade clasp, proportions, silhouette and costume seams. 4-column × 4-row transparent sheet, equal square cells, no labels/dividers, one centered full-body character at matching scale and baseline. Rows top-to-bottom: Walk_Front left contact/passing/right contact/passing; Cast_Front settle/gather/release without energy or VFX/recovery; Hit_Front anticipation/impact/recoil/recovery; Downed_Front stumble/knee/fall/settled down. Genuine distinct drawings. Dark-xianxia chibi matching master. No weapon, VFX, blur, extra character, text or watermark; keep body inside cells.

AS50_WALK.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game animation source sheet. Asset type: four genuine full-body Walk_Front cels for frozen AS50 male Dao Tu. Preserve exact master identity, face, hair, red-black-gold costume, jade clasp and proportions. Exact 2×2 transparent sheet, equal square cells, at least 12% transparent margin around every full body; read order left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Front view, clear alternating foot/weight motion, subtle coat/hair motion, stable scale/baseline. No weapon, VFX, glow, background, text or watermark.
